core_n1_disclosures.title: N=1 statistical power floor
core_n1_disclosures.detail: User mk55992@proton.me is the ONLY participant. Bootstrap CI for any per-phase r will be wide; phase-specific contrasts (P3 vs P4) lack between-subject denominator. Min detectable r at alpha=0.01 power=0.8 with N_per_phase=300 (1Hz x 5min) is ~0.16 — much better than N-1 v2 partial (~0.99) but still N=1 = no generalizability claim.
core_n1_disclosures.mitigation: Pre-registered falsifier requires consistency in >=3 of 6 phases as proxy for replication; phase-internal cross-validation only

core_n1_disclosures.title: Single 30-min session — Apr 28 D-day same limit
core_n1_disclosures.detail: 30-min single session shares the generalizability ceiling of Apr-28 D-day baseline_resting_60s_filtered (also single session). Diurnal/circadian/fatigue/state-arousal effects all confounded with phase order. Phase counter-balancing not feasible at N=1.
core_n1_disclosures.mitigation: Phase order frozen (P1->P6) so any session-level drift is constant across this run; replicate same time-of-day next session for within-subject test-retest

core_n1_disclosures.title: P3 (CLM-read) cognitive-load matching to P4 (arithmetic) NOT validated
core_n1_disclosures.detail: P3 requires user to read CLM live output and verbalize observations; P4 requires serial-7 subtraction. These are designed as matched cognitive-load controls but actual load (effort, working-memory demand, visual vs auditory modality) is NOT pre-measured. Significant asymmetry could mask CLM-specific coupling as cognitive-load artifact (or vice versa).
core_n1_disclosures.mitigation: If F-PASS_STRONG: follow-up requires NASA-TLX self-report after each phase to quantify load matching; if mismatch detected, control validity is downgraded

core_n1_disclosures.title: LSL clock drift Mac<->ubu1 ~10ms typical, can spike to 50-100ms
core_n1_disclosures.detail: Sync precision depends on LAN topology (Wi-Fi vs Ethernet, Tailscale subnet routing, multicast UDP loss). LabRecorder records both clocks but post-hoc correction is approximate. At 1Hz CLM srate any drift <500ms preserves coarse alignment, but TE/Granger lag-1 estimates could be biased if drift correlates with phase boundaries.
core_n1_disclosures.mitigation: Sync-drift rejection at +/-100ms in analyze_xdf.py; expected ~85% sample retention; flag if retention <70% in any phase

additional_disclosures.title: CLM W4 active branch is at fixed-point (std ~1e-6) BY DESIGN
additional_disclosures.detail: Per N-1 v2 partial verdict, mind_tension std = 1.04e-6. Real-time concurrent measurement does NOT change this — the channel will still be near-constant. Any non-zero r against EEG is the same degenerate-shape artifact unless gate_random or other non-degenerate channels are co-analyzed.
additional_disclosures.mitigation: anima_tension_link_5ch outlet provides 5 channels including gate_signal_random (only non-degenerate channel); analysis MAY supplement primary mind_tension test with gate_random secondary; pre-register before unblinding

additional_disclosures.title: 16ch OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy has reference-electrode constraint
additional_disclosures.detail: Cyton+Daisy uses 1-2 reference electrodes (typically A1/A2 or linked-mastoid); volume conduction can inflate cross-channel PLV. Surface Laplacian + imaginary-coherence (per N-1 v2 partial spec section 6.5) NOT implemented in analyze_xdf.py.
additional_disclosures.mitigation: Phase-2 upgrade: add scipy/mne surface-Laplacian and imag-coh; current pipeline uses raw alpha-PLV averaged over 6 pairs from {P3,P4,O1,O2}

additional_disclosures.title: F-INDETERMINATE is a real possible outcome
additional_disclosures.detail: If any phase passes some but not all PASS_STRONG criteria (e.g. |r|>0.5, p<0.01, but TE < surrogate p99 OR consistency only in 2 phases), tie-break maps to INDETERMINATE. This is NOT a failure of the protocol — it is the honest report when partial evidence does not meet pre-registered threshold.
